'''vader12 DANTOOINES GOT SPEEDERS''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[vader12]]
* '''Published:''' 2 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif|label=Dantooine Base Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dantooine Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 DBO vader12 LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits They're On Dantooine (V), Maneuvering Flaps (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Romas "Lock" Navander (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), Princess Leia (V), Bright Hope (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

a dantooine deck that utilizes speeders to lock down ground and increase drains, almost every card in this deck is pullable. PLEASE RATE

== Notes ==

* Posted 'Chewie (V)' x2: no original-era Chewie (V) legal by Nov 2004 (only VS0 and VS10); dested the printed Chewie as the brief directs. Possibly meant Chewbacca (V) (VS3).
* Posted 'Y-wing/X-wing squadron' dested Y-wing Assault Squadron / X-wing Assault Squadron; 'Han with gun' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'hoojix' Houjix; Desert, Forest, Swamp, Farm are the generic Special Edition sites.
* Original-era (V) slips: They're On Dantooine (VS3), Maneuvering Flaps/Rieekan x2/Romas "Lock" Navander/Commander Luke Skywalker (VS4), Princess Leia/Bright Hope (VS6).

== Strategy ==

STRATEGY

Rieekan is your friend, pull him with strike planning and swamp with your objective, use swamps text to pull a nudj and then drop the nudj and rieekan to the same site, don’t worry he won’t get eaten. Next turn use Rieekan to start getting out your snow speeders and maneuvering flaps for the matching pilots. Flip your objective next turn by dropping nevander who is also pullable with Rieekan and use Rieekan to pull out kessel, start dropping squadrons and when you feel you have the strength move them to kessel. You should put Rieekan in a speeder and keep him there. Get out the rest of your characters and work on holding the sites while pulling haven to make liberty drop for two less and x-wing squadrons for one. You have enough ground strength to fight off whatever comes to you and with a drain of 4 at kessel and 8 on the ground with the added help of T-47 battle formation you should be ok considering all opponents drains are minus 1. all wings report in for retrieval, the destiny adders for ground support, chewie and leia pull their own weapon, chewie pulls the destiny adders. Artillery for direct damage, and sandwhirl to lock down the desert makes this a pretty solid deck
